sentence: This project uses deep learning to improve image reconstruction algorithms for medical imaging and seismic imaging.
This project builds a tool that uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to repurpose existing drugs for treating non-small cell lung cancer.
This project builds a laboratory for hands-on practice in cybersecurity, including attack detection and mitigation at hardware, software, system and network levels.
This project develops mathematical tools to recover an unknown internal property of an object from measurements taken along lines or curves.
This project builds a microscope that records signals from neurons and blood vessels in the brain to study how the two are linked.
This project explores whether quantum computing can speed up multiscale solid mechanics calculations by estimating only the key quantities needed.
This project acquires instruments to study aerosol in urban air pollution, boreal forest fire smoke and indoor air quality at northern high latitudes.
This project tries to find out how community-based partnerships help participants gain skills with industrial robotics and manufacturing equipment.
This project uses quantum algorithms to model human dynamics across space and time and to spot unusual events in very large data sets.
This project develops methods that use isotopic shifts to tell apart isomers, molecules with the same molecular weight, using ion mobility and mass spectrometry.
This project builds statistical learning methods for high-dimensional data, including models that use few features and ways to forecast COVID-19 cases.
This project tries to find out why people miss things that are clearly in front of them and how to reduce these errors.
This project tests a compact reactor that removes toxic selenate and selenite from contaminated water and turns them into non-toxic elemental selenium using electricity.
This project studies how lanternfishes and bristlemouths adapt to changing oceans and how this affects marine food webs and carbon storage.
This project builds a computational model of the heart from 2D echocardiography scans to replicate cardiac flow and function for specific patients.
This project builds a way for machines to learn from raw video how scenes, motion and actions change over time without dense human annotation.
